description: Verifies mcp_traffic_fingerprints.py is a standalone pure library module that exports detect_mcp_methods, is_mcp_traffic, and extract_session_indicators. Runs self-smoke: python3 <module>.py exits 0 on success. Exercises detection against at least 3 known-good JSON-RPC inputs. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Per Appendix B rule 5.
